data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Memory.Ram.Short
data.value: Amount of RAM available to the emulated machine.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Memory.Ram.Detailed
data.value: Selects the RAM expansion exposed by Caprice32. The machine must restart before the new amount is used.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Firmware.Integrated.Short
data.value: The system ROM is built into Caprice32.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Firmware.Integrated.Detailed
data.value: Caprice32 provides the system ROM internally and does not expose a ROM file selector.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Video.Resolution.Short
data.value: Internal resolution rendered by Caprice32.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Video.Resolution.Detailed
data.value: Selects one of the internal resolutions exposed by Caprice32. This does not set the application window size.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Video.Monitor.Short
data.value: Type of monitor emulated by Caprice32.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Video.Monitor.Detailed
data.value: Selects a colour, green monochrome, or white monochrome CPC monitor.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Video.Intensity.Short
data.value: Brightness of the emulated monitor.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Video.Intensity.Detailed
data.value: Adjusts the monitor intensity from 5 to 15, as exposed by Caprice32.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Video.Crop.Short
data.value: Removes the external screen border.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Video.Crop.Detailed
data.value: Asks Caprice32 to crop the external border. GW GUI keeps the aspect ratio reported by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Audio.FloppySound.Short
data.value: Mechanical sound of the floppy drive.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Audio.FloppySound.Detailed
data.value: Enables or disables the floppy drive sound generated by Caprice32.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.General.Model.Short
data.value: Amstrad machine model being configured.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.General.Model.Detailed
data.value: Identifies the Amstrad CPC, Plus, or GX4000 model whose hardware configuration is being edited.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.General.Emulator.Short
data.value: Emulator selected for this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.General.Emulator.Detailed
data.value: Identifies the emulator implementation used to run this machine configuration.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Cpu.Model.Short
data.value: Processor emulated for this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Cpu.Model.Detailed
data.value: Shows the processor model provided by the selected Amstrad machine.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Cpu.Frequency.Short
data.value: Original processor clock frequency.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Cpu.Frequency.Detailed
data.value: Shows the nominal clock frequency of the processor in the selected Amstrad machine.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Audio.Enabled.Short
data.value: Enable or disable emulated sound.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Audio.Enabled.Detailed
data.value: Controls whether GW GUI plays the audio samples generated by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Audio.Output.Short
data.value: Audio output used by GW GUI.

data.name: Emulation.Amstrad.Help.Audio.Output.Detailed
data.value: Selects the Windows audio output used to play sound from this emulated machine.
